name: gradient-north-miracle
title: North Miracle
description: A loud two-colour gradient block: vivid magenta across the top sliding into bright cyan at the bottom, shaped as a wide rounded rectangle for use behind content.
use: A bold, high-energy colour field is wanted behind a launch, event or music page.
avoid: Its very bright saturated stops fight small text and calmer editorial layouts.
a11y: Decorative gradient only, so there is nothing to operate, focus or read aloud. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded rectangle on a dark stage, painted with a saturated vertical blend. Bright magenta fills the upper half and fades through violet into a glowing cyan along the bottom edge.
behaves: Static: nothing moves or responds; all frames show the same blend.
customise: Size and extra styles come through className and style; the magenta and cyan stops are hardcoded.
weight: light: One div painted with a CSS gradient; nothing animates.
issues: Frames show an inset rounded card, contradicting the packet's full-bleed footprint note.
polishWhy: Smooth even blend and clean corners; the palette is bold but generic.
